cases.text: Please confirm the FCL booking before Friday.
cases.badSuggestion: Please confirm the Full Container Load booking before Friday.
cases.why: FCL 被展开成 Full Container Load

cases.text: Kindly send the BL draft today.
cases.badSuggestion: Kindly send the Bill of Lading draft today.

cases.text: The ETD is next Monday.
cases.badSuggestion: The E.T.D is next Monday.

cases.text: We need the ATA for the last shipment.
cases.badSuggestion: We need the for the last shipment.

cases.text: The LCL cargo will be consolidated at CFS.
cases.badSuggestion: The Less-than-Container-Load cargo will be consolidated at CFS.

cases.text: We booked 2 TEU for the next vessel.
cases.badSuggestion: We booked 2 TEUs for the next vessel.

cases.text: The POD is Hamburg.
cases.badSuggestion: The PDO is Hamburg.

cases.text: Please confirm the CY is open.
cases.badSuggestion: Please confirm the Container Yard is open.

cases.text: Our price is DAP Shanghai.
cases.badSuggestion: Our price is DDP Shanghai.
cases.why: DAP 被换成 DDP（改变贸易术语）

cases.text: The CIF price includes insurance.
cases.badSuggestion: The C.I.F price includes insurance.

cases.text: Please sign the B/L and send back.
cases.badSuggestion: Please sign the BL and send back.
cases.why: B/L 变成 BL（形态改变）

cases.text: We will send the HBL copy tomorrow.
cases.badSuggestion: We will send the House B/L copy tomorrow.

cases.text: The VGM must be submitted before cut-off.
cases.badSuggestion: The must be submitted before cut-off.

cases.text: The DAP price excludes the THC.
cases.badSuggestion: The DAP price excludes the Terminal Handling Charge.

cases.text: We shipped the FCL cargo yesterday.
cases.badSuggestion: We shipped the fcl cargo yesterday.

cases.text: The ETD changed to Wednesday.
cases.badSuggestion: The Etd changed to Wednesday.

cases.text: Please confirm the FCL booking, we needs it today.
cases.badSuggestion: Please confirm the FCL booking, we need it today.

cases.text: The LCL cargo is ready.
cases.badSuggestion: The LCL cargo is ready.

cases.text: i has received your booking for FCL shipment.
cases.badSuggestion: I have received your booking for FCL shipment.
cases.why: i→I 大小写修正必须放行（D3-2）

cases.text: we will ship from china next week.
cases.badSuggestion: We will ship from China next week.

cases.text: Please confirm the SO number.
cases.badSuggestion: Please confirm the S/O number.

cases.text: So we needs the BL now.
cases.badSuggestion: So we need the BL now.
cases.why: 小写普通词 so 不算术语，动词修好放行
